scope: Prioritize deterministic, distinct-job skill evidence gaps using user-reported application and interview relevance, with the ordering and counts explained in the connected heatmap.

python_unit_and_integration.summary: Profile-scoped counts, gap/activity intersections, unknown metadata separation, deterministic priority ordering, and stale-version behavior.

connected_browser.summary: A local fixture workflow retries a transient heatmap error, ranks user-reported interview gaps before application gaps, confirms profile-scoped API data and UI text, reloads and verifies the same saved match evidence, and records no external requests.

frontend_tests.summary: Accessible loading/error/empty states, evidence caveats, priority explanation, and gap-specific outcome counts.

frontend_build.summary: TypeScript and Vite production build; existing large-chunk advisory remains.

limitations: No course/provider recommendations are generated; the slice explains deterministic skill priorities only. Full MJ-REF-026 remains PARTIAL.
Original MJ-REQ-115/MJ-REQ-120 and whole-product release acceptance remain separately tracked.
